description:
About the Grant

The University of St Andrews and the University of Bonn have launched the seventh call of the Collaborative Research Grant programme. This funding scheme fosters international research broadly, encouraging applications from all schools and disciplines for innovative and sustainable projects that link faculty at both universities. The expectation is that these initial projects will lead to long-term collaborations, institutional and research relations, and when applicable, generate publications, exhibitions, and/or external funding.

Purpose

The programme aims to support collaborative research linking faculty at the University of St Andrews and the University of Bonn. The research may take place in any country or region as long as it is done collaboratively. Applications that include students and/or collaborations across schools, disciplines, and units are encouraged.

Funding and Benefits

  • Up to GBP 10,000 from the University of St Andrews and up to EUR 11,500 from the University of Bonn per project.
  • Total of up to approximately GBP 20,000 / EUR 23,000.
  • Funds must be used for research and follow the budget guidelines.
  • Allowable expenses include airfare, accommodation, local transportation, per diems, seminar/conference costs, consumables, and hourly wages for students.
  • Non-allowable expenses include salaries, scholarships, course fees, computers, and basic computing facilities.

Eligibility and Requirements

  • Principal investigators must be full-time or part-time academic staff at the University of St Andrews with a contract until at least the end of the project.
  • Principal investigators at the University of Bonn must have completed a doctorate and be able to show proof of employment until at least the end of the project.
  • Previous St Andrews-Bonn CRG awardees are not eligible to apply before the end of their current CRG grant.
  • Mutual external collaborators can be involved at their own expense but cannot lead an application.
  • Additional partners from the GUSI network (Emory University or Hebrew University of Jerusalem) may be included, with a budget not exceeding USD 2,500 / ILS 8,000.

Selection Criteria

  • Academic quality and innovation.
  • Impact and legacy.
  • Research outcomes.
  • Partnership and strategic relevance.

Application Process

  1. Prepare a single PDF proposal including all required items: names and emails of PIs, project title and layperson abstract, names of other researchers involved, narrative description, budget and justification, CVs, and other required documents.
  2. Submit the proposal via the University of St Andrews' online submission link and via the University of Bonn's online form.
  3. Applications must be received by both universities by 6 October 2026 (4pm BST, 5pm CET).

Application dates

Call OpensWeek beginning 20 July 2026
Applications Close6 October 2026
Outcomes AnnouncedBy early December 2026
Projects Commence1 January 2027
Projects CompletedBy 31 December 2028

Official Link

https://www.st-andrews.ac.uk/research/joint-funding-programmes/bonn/

Contact

  • Global Office, University of St Andrews: Ms Harriet Sheridan, partnerships@st-andrews.ac.uk
  • International Office, University of Bonn: Dr Christian Klöckner, c.kloeckner@uni-bonn.de

Important Notes

  • Up to two applications will be funded.
  • Each project must have two principal investigators: one from St Andrews and one from Bonn.
  • Projects must be viable without a successful Global PhD Scholarship award.
  • DEI principles should be considered in the collaboration.
  • Sustainable research travel is encouraged.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 6 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
